h1.en: Ocrevus vs Tysabri vs Tecfidera: Multiple Sclerosis Drug Cost Comparison for 2026
h1.es: Ocrevus vs Tysabri vs Tecfidera: Comparacion de Costo de Medicamentos para Esclerosis Multiple en 2026

subhero.en: Ocrevus (ocrelizumab), Tysabri (natalizumab), and Tecfidera (dimethyl fumarate) are three of the most prescribed disease-modifying therapies for relapsing multiple sclerosis, and their 2026 price tags diverge enormously. Ocrevus, an infused biologic given twice a year, carries a list price near $78,858 annually and is billed through Medicare Part B. Tysabri, a monthly infusion, runs $7,500 to $9,500 per infusion without insurance, though the Tyruko biosimilar now offers roughly a 20 percent discount. Tecfidera, a twice-daily oral capsule, has had a full generic (dimethyl fumarate) since August 2020, bringing its cash price down to about $41 to $150 per month. This comparison breaks down Medicare Part B and Part D rules, manufacturer patient assistance programs, biosimilar and generic status, and billing pitfalls for all three drugs.
subhero.es: Ocrevus (ocrelizumab), Tysabri (natalizumab) y Tecfidera (dimetil fumarato) son tres de las terapias modificadoras de la enfermedad mas recetadas para la esclerosis multiple recurrente, y sus precios de 2026 son muy diferentes. Ocrevus, un biologico infundido dos veces al ano, tiene un precio de lista cercano a $78,858 anuales y se factura a traves de Medicare Parte B. Tysabri, una infusion mensual, cuesta $7,500 a $9,500 por infusion sin seguro, aunque el biosimilar Tyruko ahora ofrece aproximadamente un 20 por ciento de descuento. Tecfidera, una capsula oral dos veces al dia, tiene un generico completo (dimetil fumarato) desde agosto de 2020, lo que reduce su precio en efectivo a aproximadamente $41 a $150 por mes.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, the three drugs cost dramatically different amounts: Ocrevus lists near $78,858 per year ($16,000 to $20,000 per twice-yearly infusion), Tysabri runs $7,500 to $9,500 per monthly infusion without insurance (or about 20 percent less with the Tyruko biosimilar), and generic Tecfidera (dimethyl fumarate) costs roughly $41 to $150 per month with a discount coupon. None of the three has a CMS-negotiated Maximum Fair Price under the Inflation Reduction Act as of 2026. Ocrevus and Tysabri are billed under Medicare Part B using HCPCS codes J2350 and J2323, so the 2026 Part B deductible of $283 and 20 percent coinsurance apply, potentially exposing patients to $15,000 to $18,000 a year in coinsurance without a Medigap plan. Tecfidera is billed under Medicare Part D instead, where its cost counts toward the 2026 annual $2,100 out-of-pocket cap. Genentech, Biogen, and NeedyMeds all run separate income-based patient assistance programs that can bring any of the three drugs to $0 for eligible uninsured patients.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, los tres medicamentos cuestan cantidades muy diferentes: Ocrevus tiene un precio de lista cercano a $78,858 por ano ($16,000 a $20,000 por infusion semestral), Tysabri cuesta $7,500 a $9,500 por infusion mensual sin seguro (o aproximadamente 20 por ciento menos con el biosimilar Tyruko), y el Tecfidera generico (dimetil fumarato) cuesta aproximadamente $41 a $150 por mes con un cupon de descuento. Ninguno de los tres tiene un Precio Maximo Justo negociado por CMS bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion en 2026. Ocrevus y Tysabri se facturan bajo Medicare Parte B usando los codigos HCPCS J2350 y J2323, por lo que aplican el deducible de Parte B de 2026 de $283 y el coaseguro del 20 por ciento, lo que puede exponer a los pacientes a $15,000 a $18,000 al ano en coaseguro sin un plan Medigap. Tecfidera se factura bajo Medicare Parte D, donde su costo cuenta hacia el limite anual de bolsillo de $2,100 de 2026. Genentech, Biogen y NeedyMeds operan programas de asistencia al paciente separados basados en ingresos que pueden reducir cualquiera de los tres medicamentos a $0 para pacientes elegibles sin seguro.

introParagraphs.en: Ocrevus (ocrelizumab), Tysabri (natalizumab), and Tecfidera (dimethyl fumarate) are three of the most widely prescribed disease-modifying therapies for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, and their 2026 costs and billing pathways are almost entirely different. Ocrevus is an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody infused intravenously every six months at an infusion center or hospital outpatient department. Tysabri is an alpha-4 integrin inhibitor, also a monoclonal antibody, infused monthly, though a subcutaneous injection option exists for some patients. Tecfidera is a small-molecule Nrf2 pathway activator taken as an oral capsule twice daily at home. Because Ocrevus and Tysabri are physician-administered biologics, Medicare bills them under Part B using HCPCS codes J2350 and J2323; Tecfidera, as a self-administered oral drug, is billed under Medicare Part D instead. That single billing distinction drives most of the cost differences described on this page.
introParagraphs.es: Ocrevus (ocrelizumab), Tysabri (natalizumab) y Tecfidera (dimetil fumarato) son tres de las terapias modificadoras de la enfermedad mas recetadas para las formas recurrentes de esclerosis multiple, y sus costos y vias de facturacion de 2026 son casi completamente diferentes. Ocrevus es un anticuerpo monoclonal anti-CD20 infundido por via intravenosa cada seis meses en un centro de infusion o departamento ambulatorio hospitalario. Tysabri es un inhibidor de la integrina alfa-4, tambien un anticuerpo monoclonal, infundido mensualmente, aunque existe una opcion de inyeccion subcutanea para algunos pacientes. Tecfidera es un activador de la via Nrf2 de molecula pequena que se toma como capsula oral dos veces al dia en casa. Debido a que Ocrevus y Tysabri son biologicos administrados por un medico, Medicare los factura bajo la Parte B usando los codigos HCPCS J2350 y J2323; Tecfidera, como medicamento oral autoadministrado, se factura bajo Medicare Parte D.

introParagraphs.en: Generic and biosimilar status is the second major cost driver. Tecfidera lost its brand exclusivity in August 2020 when the FDA approved generic dimethyl fumarate from multiple manufacturers, and the generic now sells for roughly $41 to $150 per month with a discount coupon, a discount of more than 95 percent off the brand's average wholesale price. Tysabri gained its first biosimilar, Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn) from Sandoz and Polpharma, when the FDA approved it on August 25, 2023, and it launched in the US market at roughly a 20 percent discount to brand Tysabri. Ocrevus has no generic or biosimilar as of 2026; its core US patents run through approximately March 2029, and while Amgen and Celltrion both have ocrelizumab biosimilar candidates in clinical trials, none is expected to reach the US market before 2029 at the earliest.
introParagraphs.es: El estado generico y biosimilar es el segundo motor principal de costo. Tecfidera perdio su exclusividad de marca en agosto de 2020 cuando la FDA aprobo el dimetil fumarato generico de multiples fabricantes, y el generico ahora se vende por aproximadamente $41 a $150 por mes con un cupon de descuento. Tysabri obtuvo su primer biosimilar, Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn) de Sandoz y Polpharma, cuando la FDA lo aprobo el 25 de agosto de 2023, y se lanzo en el mercado de EE.UU. con aproximadamente un 20 por ciento de descuento sobre Tysabri de marca. Ocrevus no tiene generico ni biosimilar en 2026; sus patentes principales en EE.UU. se extienden hasta aproximadamente marzo de 2029.

introParagraphs.en: None of the three drugs compared here has been selected for Medicare drug price negotiation under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, and none carries a CMS-negotiated Maximum Fair Price as of 2026. Patients switching between Ocrevus, Tysabri, and Tecfidera for cost reasons should talk to their neurologist first; the three drugs work through different mechanisms, carry different infection and progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) monitoring requirements, especially for Tysabri in JC virus-positive patients, and are not clinically interchangeable. The comparison table below lays out cash price, Medicare billing pathway, generic or biosimilar status, and manufacturer patient assistance program for all three drugs side by side.
introParagraphs.es: Ninguno de los tres medicamentos comparados aqui ha sido seleccionado para la negociacion de precios de medicamentos de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, y ninguno tiene un Precio Maximo Justo negociado por CMS en 2026. Los pacientes que cambian entre Ocrevus, Tysabri y Tecfidera por razones de costo deben hablar primero con su neurologo; los tres medicamentos funcionan a traves de mecanismos diferentes y tienen diferentes requisitos de monitoreo de infecciones y leucoencefalopatia multifocal progresiva (LMP), especialmente para Tysabri en pacientes positivos al virus JC.

paragraphs.en: Hospital outpatient departments typically charge two to three times more than a freestanding infusion center for the identical Ocrevus or Tysabri infusion, because the hospital adds a separate facility fee on top of the drug charge itself. A single Ocrevus infusion billed at a hospital outpatient department can run $32,000 to $60,000 once the facility fee is layered on top of the roughly $16,000 to $20,000 drug-only cash price, while the same infusion at an independent, freestanding infusion center typically stays closer to the drug-only price. Tysabri follows the same pattern: a hospital-based infusion can run $15,000 to $28,500 per month versus $7,500 to $9,500 at a freestanding center. Patients who have a choice of infusion site should ask their neurology practice whether an independent infusion center is available in network, since the site-of-care decision alone can save tens of thousands of dollars per year.
paragraphs.es: Los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales generalmente cobran de dos a tres veces mas que un centro de infusion independiente por la misma infusion de Ocrevus o Tysabri, porque el hospital agrega un cargo de instalacion separado ademas del cargo del medicamento. Una sola infusion de Ocrevus facturada en un departamento ambulatorio hospitalario puede llegar a $32,000 a $60,000 una vez que se agrega el cargo de instalacion sobre el precio en efectivo del medicamento de aproximadamente $16,000 a $20,000, mientras que la misma infusion en un centro de infusion independiente generalmente se mantiene mas cerca del precio del medicamento solo.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part A only covers Ocrevus or Tysabri when the infusion happens during an inpatient hospital admission, which is rare for routine MS treatment; almost all Ocrevus and Tysabri infusions are outpatient and billed under Part B instead. That means the 2026 Part B annual deductible of $283 and the standard 20 percent coinsurance apply to nearly every MS infusion a Medicare beneficiary receives, and unlike Part D, Part B has no annual out-of-pocket cap unless the beneficiary carries a Medigap supplement or has Medicaid as a secondary payer. A beneficiary on Ocrevus without supplemental coverage can face roughly $15,160 a year in Part B coinsurance alone (two infusions at about $7,581 each), and a beneficiary on monthly Tysabri can face roughly $18,260 a year (twelve infusions at about $1,522 each).
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte A solo cubre Ocrevus o Tysabri cuando la infusion ocurre durante una admision hospitalaria como paciente internado, lo cual es raro para el tratamiento rutinario de EM; casi todas las infusiones de Ocrevus y Tysabri son ambulatorias y se facturan bajo la Parte B. Eso significa que el deducible anual de Parte B de 2026 de $283 y el coaseguro estandar del 20 por ciento aplican a casi cada infusion de EM que recibe un beneficiario de Medicare, y a diferencia de la Parte D, la Parte B no tiene un limite anual de bolsillo a menos que el beneficiario tenga un suplemento Medigap o Medicaid como pagador secundario.

paragraphs.en: Tecfidera sits entirely outside this hospital-charge dynamic because it is a self-administered oral capsule dispensed by a retail or mail-order pharmacy and billed through Medicare Part D, not Part A or Part B. That structural difference is the single biggest reason Tecfidera is dramatically cheaper in practice for most patients than either infused biologic, independent of the drug's own clinical effectiveness for a given patient's MS subtype. Patients switching from an infused therapy to Tecfidera, generic dimethyl fumarate, or Biogen's related oral drug Vumerity (diroximel fumarate) purely for cost reasons should discuss the switch with their neurologist, since disease activity, prior treatment response, and tolerability all factor into which DMT is clinically appropriate.
paragraphs.es: Tecfidera esta completamente fuera de esta dinamica de cargos hospitalarios porque es una capsula oral autoadministrada dispensada por una farmacia minorista o de pedido por correo y facturada a traves de Medicare Parte D, no la Parte A o B. Esa diferencia estructural es la razon principal por la que Tecfidera es dramaticamente mas barato en la practica para la mayoria de los pacientes que cualquiera de los dos biologicos infundidos. Los pacientes que cambian de una terapia infundida a Tecfidera, dimetil fumarato generico, o el medicamento oral relacionado de Biogen Vumerity (diroximel fumarato) puramente por razones de costo deben hablar con su neurologo.

intro.en: Ocrevus and Tysabri are both billed under Medicare Part B using HCPCS Level II J-codes, since they are physician-administered infusions rather than self-administered pharmacy drugs. Tecfidera has no HCPCS J-code because it is dispensed as an oral capsule through Medicare Part D.
intro.es: Ocrevus y Tysabri se facturan bajo Medicare Parte B usando codigos HCPCS Nivel II, ya que son infusiones administradas por un medico en lugar de medicamentos de farmacia autoadministrados. Tecfidera no tiene un codigo HCPCS porque se dispensa como capsula oral a traves de Medicare Parte D.

whatToLookFor.en: Confirm the claim shows 300 units per monthly infusion at the 2026 ASP+6% payment limit of roughly $23.93 per unit, and check whether the biosimilar Tyruko was billed instead of brand Tysabri if your prescriber ordered the lower-cost biosimilar.
whatToLookFor.es: Confirme que el reclamo muestre 300 unidades por infusion mensual al limite de pago ASP+6% de 2026 de aproximadamente $23.93 por unidad, y verifique si se facturo el biosimilar Tyruko en lugar de Tysabri de marca.

footnote.en: J-codes are HCPCS Level II codes used for Medicare Part B drug billing, not NDC (National Drug Code) numbers. Ask your infusion center or hospital billing department to confirm the correct J-code and unit count appear on your Explanation of Benefits.
footnote.es: Los codigos J son codigos HCPCS Nivel II usados para la facturacion de medicamentos de la Parte B de Medicare, no numeros NDC (Codigo Nacional de Medicamentos). Pida a su centro de infusion o departamento de facturacion del hospital que confirme el codigo J correcto.

intro.en: Genentech and Biogen each run a separate patient assistance program for their MS drug, and the income thresholds and application process differ across the three brands. If you have no insurance and a modest income, any of the three drugs may cost $0 through the correct manufacturer program, but you must apply to the manufacturer of your specific prescribed drug; there is no single combined MS drug assistance program.
intro.es: Genentech y Biogen operan cada uno un programa de asistencia al paciente separado para su medicamento de EM, y los umbrales de ingresos y el proceso de solicitud difieren entre las tres marcas. Si no tiene seguro y tiene un ingreso modesto, cualquiera de los tres medicamentos puede costar $0 a traves del programa correcto del fabricante.

costBenefit.es: Tecfidera de marca gratuito o a costo reducido para pacientes sin seguro con ingresos familiares generalmente por debajo del aproximadamente 400% FPL; la mayoria de los pacientes con cualquier cobertura de recetas deben preguntar primero en su farmacia sobre el dimetil fumarato generico de menor costo

costBenefit.en: Variable discount on generic Tecfidera, accepted at most US pharmacies, no income limit; does not apply to infused Ocrevus or Tysabri, which are not dispensed at retail pharmacies
costBenefit.es: Descuento variable en Tecfidera generico, aceptado en la mayoria de las farmacias de EE.UU., sin limite de ingresos; no aplica a Ocrevus o Tysabri infundidos, que no se dispensan en farmacias minoristas

footnote.en: Manufacturer copay cards for all three drugs (the Ocrevus Co-pay Program, Biogen's Tysabri copay support, and Biogen's Tecfidera copay card) are not available to Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA beneficiaries by federal law (anti-kickback statute, 42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b). If you have any government insurance, use the manufacturer's income-based patient assistance program instead of a copay card, or apply for Medicare Part D Extra Help through Social Security at 1-800-772-1213 if you take Tecfidera.
footnote.es: Las tarjetas de copago del fabricante para los tres medicamentos no estan disponibles para beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA por ley federal (estatuto anti-soborno, 42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b). Si tiene cualquier seguro del gobierno, use el programa de asistencia al paciente basado en ingresos del fabricante en su lugar.

howToApplyPap.programName: Genentech Patient Foundation - Ocrevus (representative example; steps are similar for Biogen Support Services / Above MS for Tysabri and Tecfidera)

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Call 1-888-941-3331 or visit gene.com/patients/patient-foundation (for Ocrevus), or call 1-800-456-2255 or visit abovems.com (for Tysabri or Tecfidera) to confirm eligibility for your specific drug before completing paperwork. If you have Medicare and take Tecfidera, apply for Part D Extra Help first at 1-800-772-1213.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Llame al 1-888-941-3331 o visite gene.com/patients/patient-foundation (para Ocrevus), o llame al 1-800-456-2255 o visite abovems.com (para Tysabri o Tecfidera) para confirmar la elegibilidad antes de completar el papeleo.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Download the patient application form from the manufacturer's website or request one by phone. Complete the patient section (name, address, household income, household size, insurance status) and have your neurologist complete and sign the prescriber section with a medical necessity attestation.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Descargue el formulario de solicitud del paciente desde el sitio web del fabricante o solicitelo por telefono. Complete la seccion del paciente y haga que su neurologo complete y firme la seccion del prescriptor.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather required documents: most recent federal tax return or 3 to 4 consecutive pay stubs showing household income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription for the specific MS drug, and documentation showing no current prescription drug or medical insurance covering that drug.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Reuna los documentos requeridos: declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente o 3 a 4 recibos de pago consecutivos, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene seguro que cubra ese medicamento.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Submit the completed application and documents to the manufacturer's program by fax, mail, or online portal as listed on their website. Processing typically takes 7 to 15 business days depending on the manufacturer and whether medical records are needed to confirm the infusion schedule.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Envie la solicitud completa y los documentos al programa del fabricante por fax, correo o portal en linea. El procesamiento generalmente toma 7 a 15 dias habiles.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: If approved, the manufacturer ships oral Tecfidera directly to your home, or authorizes free drug for your infusion center or hospital to administer for Ocrevus and Tysabri. Enrollment is generally valid for 12 months; annual re-enrollment requires resubmitting income documentation and a new prescriber signature.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Si es aprobado, el fabricante envia Tecfidera oral directamente a su domicilio, o autoriza medicamento gratuito para que su centro de infusion lo administre en el caso de Ocrevus y Tysabri. La inscripcion es valida por 12 meses.

documentsNeeded.es: Receta valida para el medicamento de EM especifico de un neurologo con licencia en EE.UU.

commonDenialReasons.en: Household income exceeds the manufacturer's FPL threshold for that specific drug (about 500% for Ocrevus, about 400% for Tysabri and Tecfidera)
commonDenialReasons.es: Los ingresos familiares superan el umbral FPL del fabricante para ese medicamento especifico

commonDenialReasons.en: Incomplete application or missing prescriber signature
commonDenialReasons.es: Solicitud incompleta o falta la firma del medico prescriptor

commonDenialReasons.en: Patient already has prescription drug or medical coverage that includes the specific MS drug
commonDenialReasons.es: El paciente ya tiene cobertura de medicamentos o medica que incluye el medicamento especifico de EM

commonDenialReasons.en: Not a US resident, or the prescription was written by a non-US-licensed prescriber
commonDenialReasons.es: No es residente de EE.UU., o la receta fue escrita por un medico sin licencia en EE.UU.

commonDenialReasons.en: Medicare beneficiary on Tecfidera applied to a PAP without first applying for Part D Extra Help, which some manufacturer programs require as a prerequisite
commonDenialReasons.es: Beneficiario de Medicare con Tecfidera que solicito un PAP sin antes solicitar la Ayuda Adicional de Parte D

paragraphs.en: Medicare treats these three MS drugs through two entirely different benefit structures in 2026. Ocrevus and Tysabri, as physician-administered infusions, are covered under Medicare Part B, subject to the 2026 Part B deductible of $283 and 20 percent coinsurance, with no annual out-of-pocket cap unless a Medigap plan or Medicaid covers the balance. Tecfidera, as a self-administered oral capsule, is covered under Medicare Part D instead, where cost-sharing depends on your plan's formulary tier for brand Tecfidera versus generic dimethyl fumarate, and most plans place the generic on a much lower tier with a smaller copay. All out-of-pocket Part D spending on Tecfidera counts toward the 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100; once you hit that cap across all your Part D drugs combined, you pay $0 for the rest of the calendar year.
paragraphs.es: Medicare trata a estos tres medicamentos de EM a traves de dos estructuras de beneficios completamente diferentes en 2026. Ocrevus y Tysabri, como infusiones administradas por un medico, estan cubiertos bajo Medicare Parte B, sujetos al deducible de Parte B de 2026 de $283 y coaseguro del 20 por ciento, sin limite anual de bolsillo a menos que un plan Medigap o Medicaid cubra el saldo. Tecfidera, como capsula oral autoadministrada, esta cubierto bajo Medicare Parte D en su lugar, donde el costo compartido depende del nivel de formulario de su plan.

paragraphs.en: Extra Help, the Part D Low Income Subsidy, reduces Tecfidera cost-sharing further for Medicare beneficiaries with limited income and resources. In 2026, Extra Help enrollees pay $12.65 per fill for brand Tecfidera and a smaller copay for generic dimethyl fumarate. Extra Help is generally available to beneficiaries with income at or below 150 percent of the Federal Poverty Level. There is no equivalent Extra Help program for Part B coinsurance on Ocrevus or Tysabri; Medicare beneficiaries facing high Part B coinsurance on either infusion should ask about a Medicare Savings Program through their state Medicaid agency or apply for a Medigap supplement during their Medigap open enrollment window.
paragraphs.es: Extra Help, el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos de la Parte D, reduce aun mas el costo compartido de Tecfidera para los beneficiarios de Medicare con ingresos y recursos limitados. En 2026, los inscritos en Extra Help pagan $12.65 por reposicion para Tecfidera de marca y un copago menor para dimetil fumarato generico. No existe un programa equivalente de Extra Help para el coaseguro de Parte B en Ocrevus o Tysabri; los beneficiarios de Medicare que enfrentan un alto coaseguro de Parte B deben preguntar sobre un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare a traves de la agencia estatal de Medicaid.

intro.en: Ocrevus and Tysabri are billed through Medicare Part B or a commercial medical benefit, while Tecfidera runs through Part D or a commercial pharmacy benefit, so billing problems for these three drugs show up in very different places. Watch for these issues:
intro.es: Ocrevus y Tysabri se facturan a traves de Medicare Parte B o un beneficio medico comercial, mientras que Tecfidera se factura a traves de la Parte D o un beneficio de farmacia comercial. Verifique estos problemas:

items.en: Infusion center or hospital bills more than the ASP+6% Medicare Part B payment limit for J2350 (Ocrevus) or J2323 (Tysabri) in 2026, which can indicate an incorrect unit count or an out-of-network facility fee; ask billing to reconcile the claim against the published CMS ASP file.
items.es: El centro de infusion o el hospital cobra mas del limite de pago ASP+6% de la Parte B de Medicare para J2350 (Ocrevus) o J2323 (Tysabri) en 2026, lo que puede indicar un conteo de unidades incorrecto o un cargo de instalacion fuera de la red.

items.en: Generic dimethyl fumarate billed at the brand-name Tecfidera price instead of the generic tier.
items.es: Dimetil fumarato generico facturado al precio de marca de Tecfidera en lugar del nivel generico.

items.en: Manufacturer copay card applied for a patient who has Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA coverage, which is prohibited and can result in a claim clawback later.
items.es: Tarjeta de copago del fabricante aplicada a un paciente que tiene cobertura de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA, lo cual esta prohibido y puede resultar en una recuperacion del reclamo mas tarde.

items.en: Step therapy denial requiring a trial of a lower-cost, first-line DMT before approving Ocrevus or Tysabri, without documenting that the required first-step drug was already tried and failed or is clinically inappropriate.
items.es: Denegacion de terapia escalonada que requiere probar un DMT de primera linea de menor costo antes de aprobar Ocrevus o Tysabri, sin documentar que el medicamento requerido ya se probo y fallo.

items.en: Brand Tysabri billed under J2323 when the lower-cost Tyruko biosimilar was actually infused, or vice versa, which can trigger an incorrect copay or coinsurance calculation.
items.es: Tysabri de marca facturado bajo J2323 cuando en realidad se infundio el biosimilar Tyruko de menor costo, o viceversa, lo que puede provocar un calculo incorrecto de copago o coaseguro.

items.en: Charged the standard Tecfidera copay after you already hit the $2,100 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap for the year across all your combined Part D drugs.
items.es: Se le cobro el copago estandar de Tecfidera despues de que ya alcanzo el limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de $2,100 para el ano entre todos sus medicamentos combinados de Parte D.

genericBiosimilarStatus.genericName: dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera generic, since August 2020); natalizumab biosimilar Tyruko available for Tysabri since 2024; no generic or biosimilar for Ocrevus as of 2026

relativeCost.es: Aproximadamente 20% menos que Tysabri de marca

note.en: The three MS drugs have three different generic and biosimilar outcomes in 2026. Tecfidera (dimethyl fumarate) has had full generic competition since August 2020, when the FDA approved generic 240mg capsules from multiple manufacturers, cutting the cash price by more than 95 percent compared to brand. Tysabri (natalizumab) gained its first and, as of 2026, only biosimilar, Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn) from Sandoz and Polpharma Biologics, FDA-approved August 25, 2023 and launched in the US in 2024 at roughly a 20 percent discount to brand Tysabri; it is administered the same way as brand Tysabri and billed under the same HCPCS code, J2323. Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) has no generic or biosimilar available in the US as of 2026. Its core US patents extend to approximately March 2029, and while Amgen (ABP 692) and Celltrion (CT-P53) both have ocrelizumab biosimilar candidates in clinical development, neither is expected to reach the US market before the patent cliff around 2029.
note.es: Los tres medicamentos de EM tienen tres resultados genericos y biosimilares diferentes en 2026. Tecfidera (dimetil fumarato) ha tenido competencia generica completa desde agosto de 2020, cuando la FDA aprobo capsulas genericas de 240mg de multiples fabricantes, reduciendo el precio en efectivo en mas del 95 por ciento comparado con la marca. Tysabri (natalizumab) obtuvo su primer y, hasta 2026, unico biosimilar, Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn) de Sandoz y Polpharma Biologics, aprobado por la FDA el 25 de agosto de 2023 y lanzado en EE.UU. en 2024 con aproximadamente un 20 por ciento de descuento sobre Tysabri de marca. Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) no tiene generico ni biosimilar disponible en EE.UU. en 2026. Sus patentes principales en EE.UU. se extienden hasta aproximadamente marzo de 2029.

caption.en: PAP eligibility by household size at 500% FPL, the Genentech Patient Foundation threshold for Ocrevus (2026)
caption.es: Elegibilidad PAP por tamano del hogar al 500% FPL, el umbral de la Fundacion de Pacientes de Genentech para Ocrevus (2026)

papEligibilityTable.source: HHS 2026 federal poverty guidelines (https://aspe.hhs.gov/poverty-guidelines) applied at the Genentech Patient Foundation's approximately 500% FPL threshold for Ocrevus. Biogen Support Services / Above MS for Tysabri and Tecfidera uses approximately 400% FPL; multiply the 100% FPL base ($15,960 for household size 1 in 2026) by 4 to find that threshold.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurer or Medicare plan. Federal law requires written notice within 72 hours for standard decisions, or 24 hours for expedited (urgent) requests, stating the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su aseguradora o plan de Medicare. La ley federal requiere aviso escrito dentro de las 72 horas para decisiones estandar, o 24 horas para solicitudes urgentes.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal appeal within 60 days of the written denial. Include a neurologist's letter documenting relapse activity, MRI findings, or prior treatment failure that supports the medical necessity of the specific MS drug prescribed.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias del aviso de denegacion por escrito. Incluya una carta del neurologo que documente la actividad de recaida, hallazgos de RM o fallo de tratamiento previo.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your neurologist to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director, documenting why the required step-therapy alternative is contraindicated, already failed, or carries specific risk given JC virus status or other comorbidities.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Solicite a su neurologo que pida una revision medico a medico con el director medico del plan, documentando por que la alternativa de terapia escalonada requerida esta contraindicada o ya fallo.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the internal appeal is denied, escalate to an Independent Review Entity for Medicare Part B or Part D plans at 1-800-633-4227, or to your state Department of Insurance for commercial plans. Medicare beneficiaries can also contact their State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for free counseling.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si la apelacion interna es denegada, escale a una Entidad de Revision Independiente para planes de Medicare al 1-800-633-4227, o al Departamento de Seguros de su estado para planes comerciales.

stepTherapyOverride.en: If your plan requires step therapy, trying a lower-cost, first-line disease-modifying therapy before approving Ocrevus or Tysabri, your neurologist can file a step-therapy exception by documenting that the required first-step drug is medically contraindicated, was already tried and failed (breakthrough relapses, new MRI lesions, or intolerance), or that requiring it would cause serious harm given active or aggressive disease activity. Medicare and most state laws require plans to decide on a step-therapy exception within 72 hours of complete documentation, or 24 hours for urgent cases.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada, probando una terapia modificadora de la enfermedad de primera linea y menor costo antes de aprobar Ocrevus o Tysabri, su neurologo puede presentar una excepcion de terapia escalonada documentando que el medicamento de primer paso requerido esta medicamente contraindicado o ya fallo.

papFallback.en: If all insurance appeals fail, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug: the Genentech Patient Foundation (gene.com/patients/patient-foundation) for Ocrevus, or Biogen Support Services / Above MS (abovems.com) for Tysabri or Tecfidera. Each has a different FPL threshold, so check the one that applies to your prescribed drug before assuming you do not qualify.
papFallback.es: Si todas las apelaciones de seguro fallan, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su medicamento especifico: la Fundacion de Pacientes de Genentech para Ocrevus, o Biogen Support Services / Above MS para Tysabri o Tecfidera.

genericAlternative.en: Generic dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) is the lowest-cost alternative among the three, at $41 to $150 per month, and the natalizumab biosimilar Tyruko offers roughly a 20 percent discount over brand Tysabri at the same HCPCS code and dosing schedule. No generic or biosimilar exists for Ocrevus as of 2026. None of the three drugs is clinically interchangeable without a neurologist's evaluation; switching purely for cost should always be discussed with your prescriber first.
genericAlternative.es: El dimetil fumarato generico (Tecfidera) es la alternativa de menor costo entre los tres, a $41 a $150 por mes, y el biosimilar de natalizumab Tyruko ofrece aproximadamente un 20 por ciento de descuento sobre Tysabri de marca. No existe generico ni biosimilar para Ocrevus en 2026.

en.question: Is there a generic or biosimilar for Ocrevus, Tysabri, or Tecfidera?
en.answer: Yes for two of the three. Tecfidera has a full generic (dimethyl fumarate) available since August 2020, cutting the cost by more than 95 percent compared to brand. Tysabri has a biosimilar, Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn), FDA-approved in August 2023 and available since 2024 at roughly a 20 percent discount. Ocrevus has no generic or biosimilar as of 2026; its core US patents run through approximately March 2029.

en.question: How do I apply for the Genentech or Biogen patient assistance program?
en.answer: Contact the manufacturer of your specific drug: the Genentech Patient Foundation at 1-888-941-3331 or gene.com/patients/patient-foundation for Ocrevus, or Biogen Support Services at 1-800-456-2255 or abovems.com for Tysabri or Tecfidera. Each requires proof of income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription, and documentation that you have no insurance covering that drug. Processing takes 7 to 15 business days, and approved patients typically receive a 12-month benefit that requires annual re-enrollment.

en.question: Can I use an MS drug manufacturer copay card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) bars Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and VA beneficiaries from using any manufacturer copay card or manufacturer coupon, including the Ocrevus Co-pay Program and Biogen's copay cards for Tysabri and Tecfidera. Medicare patients on Tecfidera should apply for Part D Extra Help instead, and Medicare patients on Ocrevus or Tysabri facing high Part B coinsurance should apply for a Medicare Savings Program through their state Medicaid agency or the manufacturer's income-based patient assistance program.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for Ocrevus, Tysabri, or Tecfidera?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice, then file a formal appeal within 60 days with a neurologist's letter documenting medical necessity, relapse activity, or MRI findings. If your plan requires step therapy with a cheaper DMT first, your neurologist can file a step-therapy exception documenting contraindication, prior failure, or active disease risk. If the appeal fails, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug as a fallback.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated Medicare price apply to Ocrevus, Tysabri, or Tecfidera?
en.answer: No. None of the three has been selected for Medicare drug price negotiation under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, and none carries a CMS-negotiated Maximum Fair Price as of 2026. Ocrevus and Tysabri instead fall under standard Medicare Part B ASP-based pricing with 20 percent coinsurance, and Tecfidera falls under the general 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100 like any other non-negotiated Part D drug.

en.question: What does each MS drug cost without insurance in 2026?
en.answer: Ocrevus lists near $78,858 per year, or $16,000 to $20,000 per twice-yearly infusion. Tysabri runs $7,500 to $9,500 per monthly infusion, or roughly 20 percent less with the Tyruko biosimilar. Generic Tecfidera (dimethyl fumarate) costs $41 to $150 per month with a discount coupon; brand Tecfidera without a coupon can run close to $7,200 per month at cash pricing.

en.question: Do I qualify for an MS drug patient assistance program based on my income?
en.answer: It depends on which drug you take. The Genentech Patient Foundation for Ocrevus generally uses an income cutoff around 500% of the Federal Poverty Level ($79,800 for one person in 2026). Biogen Support Services / Above MS for Tysabri and Tecfidera generally uses roughly 400% FPL. Check the specific program for your prescribed drug rather than assuming one threshold applies to all three.

en.question: Is Ocrevus the same as Wegovy or Ozempic? What is the difference between Tecfidera and Vumerity?
en.answer: Ocrevus is not related to Wegovy or Ozempic; it is an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody for multiple sclerosis, while Wegovy and Ozempic are GLP-1 receptor agonists for weight management and diabetes. Vumerity (diroximel fumarate) is a related Biogen drug that converts to the same active metabolite as Tecfidera (dimethyl fumarate) but is formulated to cause less gastrointestinal upset; Vumerity has no generic as of 2026, so switching from brand Tecfidera to generic dimethyl fumarate is typically the lower-cost option unless GI tolerability is a specific concern.

es.question: ¿Hay un generico o biosimilar para Ocrevus, Tysabri o Tecfidera?
es.answer: Si para dos de los tres. Tecfidera tiene un generico completo (dimetil fumarato) disponible desde agosto de 2020, reduciendo el costo en mas del 95 por ciento comparado con la marca. Tysabri tiene un biosimilar, Tyruko (natalizumab-sztn), aprobado por la FDA en agosto de 2023 y disponible desde 2024 con aproximadamente un 20 por ciento de descuento. Ocrevus no tiene generico ni biosimilar en 2026; sus patentes principales se extienden hasta aproximadamente marzo de 2029.

es.question: ¿Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente de Genentech o Biogen?
es.answer: Contacte al fabricante de su medicamento especifico: la Fundacion de Pacientes de Genentech al 1-888-941-3331 o gene.com/patients/patient-foundation para Ocrevus, o Biogen Support Services al 1-800-456-2255 o abovems.com para Tysabri o Tecfidera. Cada uno requiere comprobante de ingresos, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene seguro. El procesamiento toma 7 a 15 dias habiles.

es.question: ¿Puedo usar una tarjeta de copago del fabricante de un medicamento de EM con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe a los beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE y VA usar cualquier tarjeta de copago del fabricante, incluyendo el Programa de Copago de Ocrevus y las tarjetas de copago de Biogen para Tysabri y Tecfidera. Los pacientes de Medicare con Tecfidera deben solicitar la Ayuda Adicional de la Parte D en su lugar.

es.question: ¿Que hago si mi seguro deniega la cobertura de Ocrevus, Tysabri o Tecfidera?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito, luego presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias con una carta del neurologo que documente la necesidad medica. Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada con un DMT mas barato primero, su neurologo puede presentar una excepcion documentando contraindicacion o fallo previo. Si la apelacion falla, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su medicamento especifico.

es.question: ¿Aplica el precio negociado de la IRA de Medicare a Ocrevus, Tysabri o Tecfidera?
es.answer: No. Ninguno de los tres ha sido seleccionado para la negociacion de precios de medicamentos de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, y ninguno tiene un Precio Maximo Justo negociado por CMS en 2026. Ocrevus y Tysabri caen bajo el precio estandar basado en ASP de la Parte B de Medicare con coaseguro del 20 por ciento, y Tecfidera cae bajo el limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de 2026 de $2,100.

es.question: ¿Cuanto cuesta cada medicamento de EM sin seguro en 2026?
es.answer: Ocrevus tiene un precio de lista cercano a $78,858 por ano, o $16,000 a $20,000 por infusion semestral. Tysabri cuesta $7,500 a $9,500 por infusion mensual, o aproximadamente 20 por ciento menos con el biosimilar Tyruko. El Tecfidera generico (dimetil fumarato) cuesta $41 a $150 por mes con un cupon de descuento.

es.question: ¿Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente de un medicamento de EM segun mis ingresos?
es.answer: Depende de que medicamento tome. La Fundacion de Pacientes de Genentech para Ocrevus generalmente usa un limite de ingresos de alrededor del 500% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($79,800 para una persona en 2026). Biogen Support Services / Above MS para Tysabri y Tecfidera generalmente usa aproximadamente 400% FPL.

es.question: ¿Es Ocrevus lo mismo que Wegovy u Ozempic? ¿Cual es la diferencia entre Tecfidera y Vumerity?
es.answer: Ocrevus no esta relacionado con Wegovy ni Ozempic; es un anticuerpo monoclonal anti-CD20 para esclerosis multiple, mientras que Wegovy y Ozempic son agonistas del receptor GLP-1 para el control de peso y la diabetes. Vumerity (diroximel fumarato) es un medicamento relacionado de Biogen que se convierte en el mismo metabolito activo que Tecfidera pero causa menos molestias gastrointestinales; Vumerity no tiene generico en 2026.
